description:
## Goal

Build visibility into ecosystem-manager's loop performance: how much each iteration costs (tokens), how long it takes, and whether the scenario is improving over time.

## Implementation

### Data Sources (Already Tracked)
- **ExecutionHistory** already captures: duration, prompt size, exit reason, Auto Steer iteration/phase, steering source
- **Git Control Tower reviews** (from ecosystem-git-control-tower-integration): per-iteration health dimensions and regression flags

### New Data to Surface
- **Token usage:** Pull from agent-manager run metadata (total tokens consumed per execution)
- **Duration trends:** Chart execution duration across iterations to detect performance drift
- **Success rate:** Rolling success/failure ratio with trend indicators
- **Cost per iteration:** Estimated cost based on token usage and model pricing
- **Health dimension trends:** Overlay code quality, test, and standards scores across iterations

### UI Components
- **Task Performance Dashboard:** Per-task view showing iteration-over-iteration trends
- **Sparkline indicators** on task cards (success rate, duration trend, cost trend)
- **System-wide summary:** Aggregate metrics across all active tasks

### API Endpoints
- Task performance summary endpoint (aggregated stats for a task's execution history)
- System performance summary endpoint (cross-task aggregation)

## Key References

- Execution history: `scenarios/ecosystem-manager/api/pkg/queue/execution_history.go`
- Insight types: `scenarios/ecosystem-manager/api/pkg/insights/types.go` (ExecutionStatistics already has TotalExecutions, SuccessRate, AvgDuration, etc.)
- Agent-manager run data: `scenarios/ecosystem-manager/api/pkg/agentmanager/agentmanager.go`
name: ecosystem-cost-performance-visibility
title: Surface Token Usage, Duration Trends, and Success Rates Across Loop Iterations
